title: Fix Arc Preview and Output
description: The arc command doesn't preview correctly (no curve rendering for arc/circle-outline preview kinds) and produces wrong output (kernel reads radiusPoint instead of start)
summary: Investigated the Vite runtime error. Found that spatial/js/kernel-brepjs/index.ts imports getCachedShapeKind from brepjs, but brepjs 18.20.3 does not publicly export that symbol from its package root. Vite's optimized dependency contains an internal function with that name, but the final export list omits it, so the browser ESM loader rejects the import. Public replacement appears to be getShapeKind from brepjs/core/root exports, or a refactor away from the private cached topology helper.
